text:
maria: quick sync: we're still losing useful dmesg/journal snippets for GPU failures. Without them triage takes forever :(

jake: agree. most bundles only include last 1k lines; need pre-failure window + nv driver logs.

priya: proposal: standard snippet = `dmesg -T --level=err,warn -x` + `journalctl -k -b -1 --no-pager | tail -n 500` and `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,UTILIZATION -l 1 -f /tmp/gpu-sample.txt` ???

chris: we should avoid heavy sampling on every node. instead: on failure event, collect 1m of nvidia-smi at 2s intervals and compress.

rachel: also include kernel version, driver, firmware, pci slot, serial. those are key for matching flaky cards.

devops-bot: alert: node gpu-42 drained automatically after repeated Xid 31 events. bundle id: bndl-1998765432

jake: heuristics: if same pci id sees >3 Xid 31 within 15m mark as 'likely card' and schedule probe/replace. For ECC errors use nvml counters (nvmlDeviceGetEccErrorCounts).

priya: we need parsing rules. suggested regex for Xid line: `(?i)(NVRM|Xid)\s+(\d+):\s*(.*)` also handle 'Ecc error' and 'GPU reset' variants.

maria: we should route small 'fast snippets' to fast-path indexer (keeps last 2 hours) and full bundles to cold storage. TTL for fast-path 48h.

chris: how to tag snippets: labels: node, rack, region, gpu-slot, driver, kernel, failure-ts, alert-id

rachel: quick helpful command for oncall: `sudo journalctl -k --since '5 minutes ago' | grep -i -E 'NVRM|Xid|GPU|ecc'` and `dmesg -T | tail -n 200`

jake: we should capture nv-hostengine/sysfs errors too. include `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log` and `dmesg -T -x` output if present.

priya: do we want to send these snippets as JSON lines? e.g., one doc per event with fields -> easier to query.

maria: yes, send as jsonl with an envelope: {node,ts,type,raw}. keep raw as single string; compress if >10kb.

chris: ops question: who owns the ship? I'm happy to implement collector change this week.

maria: @chris awesome. can you open PR? target: add fast-snippet route + label enrichment. ping oncall when ready.

chris: on it. will post PR and short rollout plan. :thumbsup:
